# Harbour Loaf

*A long crusty loaf to share along the waterfront. Restores 300 HP and a fifth of your HP.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Type | Consumable |
| Effect | Restores 300 HP and 20% HP |
| Sells for | 260 mesos |

## How to get

- Dropped by [Dusk Wolf](../monsters/dusk_wolf.md) (2%)
- Dropped by [Glimshade](../monsters/glimshade.md) (2%)
- Dropped by [Hookshade](../monsters/hookshade.md) (2%)
- Dropped by [Whipshade](../monsters/whipshade.md) (2%)

- Reward from [The Bright Morrow's Night Run](../runs/the_night_run.md)
